name: Sales Orchestrator
tagline: Traffic control for a group chat full of sales bots
description: Drop it into a group with your other sales assistants and it answers first, every time. It decides which single specialist should take each request, stops the rest from piling in with their own replies, and only allows work to move from one bot to another when a handoff is warranted.
author: idleshubh
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
